exchanges: hey, long day, finally sitting down with some tea
Sounds well earned, enjoy the quiet.
first week at the arboretum done, my feet are wrecked from walking the trails
Congrats on getting through the first week, that sounds like a lovely place to work.
its supposed to rain all weekend which kinda ruins my plans
That's a shame, maybe a good excuse for a cozy weekend in.
my sister finally named her puppy, mungo lol
Ha, that's a great name for a puppy.
been going bouldering after work, my forearms are dead
That's brutal on the forearms, but it gets easier.
do you ever just forget what day it is
All the time, the week blurs together sometimes.
my sister in law has a cat called tolliver and he hates everyone
Some cats just pick their one person, if any.
ordered pizza, no regrets
Pizza night is always a good call.
my brother orrin is coming to stay for a few days, need to clean the spare room
A visit from family is worth the tidying.
dara picked me up in her ancient saab, the heater doesnt even work
A car with no heat makes for a chilly ride.
kinda nervous about the staff meeting tomorrow
You'll be fine, early meetings are usually just introductions.
doc says its tendonitis in my wrist so no climbing for a while
Sorry to hear it, rest should help it heal.
made soup with whatever was in the fridge and it actually turned out good
Fridge soup is an underrated art.
dad was telling stories about growing up in kilbarra again, he really misses it
It's sweet that he still holds onto those memories.
my brother is bringing his wife too so the house is gonna be packed
A full house can be fun for a few days.
dara works as a farrier, she was telling me about horses kicking her lol
That sounds tough but pretty interesting.
the weather turned and now its sunny, typical
Classic, the forecast never gets it right.
started watching hollowmere last night and im already way too many episodes in
Sounds like it hooked you fast.
my neighbour wendell bought a trampoline for his kids and the noise is unreal
At least the kids are having fun.
might go to the farmers market sunday
That sounds like a nice way to spend the morning.
my phone died again, this motorola is on its last legs
Might be time to start looking at a replacement.
feeling better today honestly, just tired
Glad to hear it, rest up tonight.
turns out my sister's puppy is a whippet, she thought he was a mutt
That explains the skinny legs and all the speed.
ok gonna head to bed, night
Good night, sleep well.
